biggest_catch: The $200 requires holding a $3,000 average daily balance for three full months; each component is earned separately as uChoose Rewards points (not cash) and you must enroll in uChoose Rewards within 30 days or earn nothing.
catches: The headline $200 is paid as 20,000 uChoose Rewards points (100 points = $1 in cash value), not a cash deposit; uChoose Rewards is not affiliated with Hanmi Bank.
Points must be redeemed at uchooserewards.com for cash back or gift cards; points expire 3 years from the month credited.
You must enroll in uChoose Rewards within 30 calendar days of account opening and remain enrolled for point crediting on the payout date — missing enrollment forfeits the bonus.
Largest component (10,000 points = $100) requires a $3,000 average daily balance across the first three full months — significant tied-up capital for a $100 reward.
Debit component (5,000 points = $50) requires $250+ in point-of-sale debit purchases in EACH of the first three full months; ATM withdrawals do not count.
eStatement component (5,000 points = $50) requires enrollment within 30 days and being enrolled in online banking.
New personal checking customers only: no existing Hanmi personal checking relationship within the past 60 days; one eligible account per customer (SSN).
Account must remain open at payout; points credit within 30 days after the first three full months.
Offer subject to change and may be discontinued at any time without notice.
Official terms page carries no explicit IRS/tax reporting language.

steps: Open a new Hanmi personal checking account at any Hanmi Bank branch or at Hanmi.com (must be a new personal checking customer — no Hanmi checking relationship in the past 60 days).
Order and activate your Hanmi debit card and enroll it in uChoose Rewards at uchooserewards.com within 30 days of account opening.
Maintain an average daily balance of $3,000 or higher for the first three full months after opening to earn 10,000 points.
Enroll in eStatements within 30 days of opening (online banking enrollment required) to earn 5,000 points.
Make at least $250 in point-of-sale debit-card purchases in each of the first three full months to earn 5,000 points.
Points are credited to the uChoose Rewards account within 30 days after all requirements are met; redeem at uchooserewards.com for cash back, gift cards, and more (100 points = $1).
timing: Points credited within 30 days after the first three full months of account opening. eStatement enrollment and uChoose Rewards enrollment must occur within 30 days of opening. Offer valid 1/1/2026 to 12/31/2026.
